oneLine: Live gigs in old-school jazz and trad Americana (minus bluegrass) around London and reachable from Surbiton.
genresWanted: swing (hot, pre-bebop) incl. live-band swing/Lindy dances
avoid: bluegrass-only acts and bluegrass festivals (explicitly out of scope)
modern / contemporary / bebop / hard-bop / post-bop / fusion / nu-jazz / free jazz
modern pop / chart / Nashville country and country-pop
indie-folk, singer-songwriter, folk-rock unless clearly old-time/trad
rock, punk, metal, indie, electronic, DJ nights, tribute acts
anything with no confirmed specific date, or evidence of a stale prior-year listing

scope.core: Greater London, prioritising what is easy from Surbiton (SW London: Surbiton, Kingston, Wimbledon, Richmond, Twickenham, Barnes, Putney; and central London via Waterloo).
scope.dayTrip: Include events within ~90 min by train (e.g. Brighton, Guildford, Oxford, Cambridge, St Albans, East Grinstead) with a clear travel note.
scope.overnightOnly: Note genuinely relevant festivals that are too far for a day-trip in the watchlist, not the main list.

reviewPolicy.inclusionNote: Within the wanted genres, nearby/easy gigs can be included with a lower threshold. Central London should have a clear genre, venue, artist or date-night reason. Day-trip gigs need a stronger match or rare/high-quality pull. Always avoid bluegrass-only, modern jazz/fusion, modern country, generic open mics, and anything similar to exported user feedback unless clearly different.

prefer: artist/band official sites and tour pages
ticketing pages (DICE, TicketSource, See Tickets, WeGotTickets, Eventbrite) for the specific gig
useWithCaution: aggregators (Songkick, Bandsintown, Ents24, Skiddle) — good for discovery, confirm the date on a primary source where possible
social-only listings (Instagram/Facebook) — allowed but mark confidence:verify
pages with no explicit current-year date
